about.subtitle: // PROFILE_DETAILS_AND_SKILLSET
about.bio1: I am a Software Engineer with a strong focus on Frontend Web Development and building responsive, secure, and user-centric systems. My expertise centers on designing scalable applications with Angular, utilizing its full power from architecture and reactive state management to performance tuning.
about.bio2: Over 6+ years of professional experience, I have successfully digitized critical workflows for public administration (government systems) and automated complex tasks in clinical and corporate environments.
about.bio3: I believe software development is the perfect union between engineering precision and creative problem solving. I am currently pursuing a Master's degree in Web UI Design & Development to continue bridging the gap between clean code and high-fidelity user experiences.
about.whatIDoText: Development of robust user interfaces, single-page reactive web applications, and high-security administrative portals.
about.myApproachText: Clean architecture, component modularity, optimized reactivity (Signals), strict typing, and a relentless focus on performance and accessibility.
about.enjoyText: Complex dynamic form architectures, offline-first interactive widgets, and high-impact digital government systems.

proj.surticel.subtitle: B2B ordering platform · Fresh produce
proj.surticel.overview: Online ordering platform for a fresh produce supplier in Celaya, Mexico. Business customers browse a catalog with up-to-date prices and stock, build their order in minutes and track delivery right to their door.
proj.surticel.problem: Customer orders were taken over the phone or by message, with no visibility into prices, stock or delivery status.
proj.surticel.challenge: Build a fast, reliable mobile experience for customers ordering in the middle of their workday, with an always-current catalog and status updates for every order.
proj.surticel.solution: Installable PWA with a categorized catalog, cart, order history and tracking, Web Push notifications and light/dark themes.
proj.surticel.architecture: Angular SPA with Tailwind CSS; Supabase as the backend (authentication and PostgreSQL database) and a service worker for installation and push notifications.
proj.surticel.role: Full-Stack Developer — Designed and built the platform end to end: UI, data model, authentication and deployment.
proj.surticel.result1: Catalog with always-current prices and stock
proj.surticel.result2: Order tracking from confirmation to delivery
proj.surticel.result4: Optimized loading: AVIF images and hero preload
proj.constancias.title: Constancias de Inexistencia (Civil Registry)
proj.constancias.overview: Issuance and management of non-existence records for the General Directorate of Civil Registry. Digitizes key administrative government procedures, speeding up citizen service through cryptographic validation and digital signatures.
proj.constancias.problem: Certificate search and issuance processes took 10 to 15 business days due to manual processing and fragmented legacy records.
proj.constancias.challenge: Design a secure, fast, and resilient portal for automated query and issuance of non-existence certificates, connecting legacy databases and guaranteeing document validity.
proj.constancias.solution: Web platform with fast indexed search, smart forms, and a document integrity validator based on SHA-256 hash.
proj.constancias.architecture: Decoupled SPA architecture built on Angular 17 for the frontend with material design components, interacting via secure REST APIs created in Python (FastAPI).
proj.constancias.role: Lead Full-Stack Developer — Responsible for frontend architecture in Angular 17, database design, and secure file upload workflows.
proj.constancias.problemsSolved: Inefficient manual workflows, high probability of human typo errors, and loss of books containing physical certificate data.
proj.constancias.technicalChallenges: Optimizing indexed searches over large dataset queries and secure generation of unalterable SHA-256 hash signatures.
proj.constancias.metric1: Reduction of processing time from 15 days to under 5 minutes.
proj.constancias.metric2: Over 20,000 citizens served and certificates successfully generated.
proj.constancias.metric3: 100% of documents validated via secure cryptographic hash signatures.
proj.constancias.lessons: Strict modularization and offline-first query designs significantly reduce network load, while SHA-256 hashing completely prevents document spoofing.
proj.celebraya.title: Celebra-Ya Studio
proj.celebraya.overview: Custom digital invitation studio for weddings, quinceañeras, baptisms and special events: a business site with a portfolio filterable by event type, priced packages and quote requests.
proj.celebraya.problem: Printed or image-based invitations can't confirm attendance, guide guests to the venue or control guest access.
proj.celebraya.solution: Web invitations with a live countdown, Google Maps and Waze directions, WhatsApp RSVP, HD gallery and individual QR passes, plus a sales site with a catalog and packages.
proj.celebraya.role: Founder & Developer — Designed, built and deployed the studio's site and every invitation.
proj.celebraya.metrics: Delivery in 48 hours to 7 days. QR passes for events of up to 250 guests.
proj.logpath.title: LogPath (midudev Hackathon)
proj.logpath.overview: Edge-to-Cloud telemetry architecture for POS systems. Audits transactions in real-time with an error interceptor.
proj.logpath.problem: Lack of visibility and inability to diagnose issues on remote payment terminals before receiving client complaints.
proj.logpath.solution: Agent in .NET 10 and Angular 19 web panel to monitor critical events in real-time and send auto-alerts via Discord Webhooks.
proj.logpath.role: Full-Stack Developer — Designed the reactive dashboard interface and connected real-time telemetry flows.
proj.logpath.metrics: Event alert latency < 150ms. Automated network telemetry.
proj.anotaciones.title: Anotaciones Judiciales
proj.anotaciones.overview: Digital platform for the Civil Registry to register and audit marginal notes and legal rectifications.
proj.anotaciones.problem: Marginal notes on certificates were prone to transcription errors, physical loss, and search delays in paper books.
proj.anotaciones.solution: Transactional database with strict audit logs, approval workflows, and quick search panels.
proj.anotaciones.role: Lead Frontend Developer — Implemented the complete web UI, role-based access control, and the stamp printing system.
proj.anotaciones.metrics: Over 10,000 records indexed and digitized. Error rate at 0%.
proj.posmiche.title: POS Miche LTS
proj.posmiche.overview: High-speed cross-platform Point of Sale and inventory control app for mobile and desktop.
proj.posmiche.problem: Conventional POS systems were slow, incompatible with Android tablets, and dependent on constant connectivity.
proj.posmiche.solution: Responsive hybrid app with background synchronization of local database and Firebase.
proj.posmiche.role: Mobile & Frontend Developer — Designed the mobile UI and the hybrid build using Capacitor.
proj.posmiche.metrics: Over 5,000 monthly transactions processed without interruptions.
proj.purplewings.title: Purple Wings
proj.purplewings.overview: Online ordering app for a charcoal-grilled chicken wings business in Celaya, Mexico, with its own visual identity and a mobile-first checkout flow.
proj.purplewings.problem: Orders arrived as scattered messages with no clear quantities, total or delivery details, causing mistakes and back-and-forth confirmations.
proj.purplewings.solution: Package selector with a live total, delivery form and a ready-made order sent via WhatsApp, plus a shareable link and QR code.
proj.purplewings.role: Frontend Developer — Designed the app's visual identity and built the ordering flow in Angular.
proj.purplewings.metrics: Complete order in a single WhatsApp message, ready in ~15–20 minutes.
